Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BAC.
Our gross margin expanded by 186 basis points to 20.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2022.
We generated $14.6 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $49.7 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $9.6 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 6% to 18% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
